dffc0e8: +-- Starter database: apps, votes, scores and points
+-- From the factory kit (Sloppy's Factory, idea by Flax). Generic and public: nothing in here is secret.
+-- Written for Postgres 15 or newer with row-level security (RLS).
+-- auth.uid() is the id of the signed-in visitor and "authenticated" is the role
+-- signed-in visitors get. Hosted Postgres services such as Supabase provide both.
+-- On another host, swap in your own function and role.
+-- Run it once: paste it into your database's SQL editor, or
+-- Running it again is safe: tables are only created when missing, and the rules are replaced.
+-- Try it on an empty test database first, never on real players' rows.
+-- 1. apps: one row per app on your shelf
+  slug        text primary key check (slug ~ '^[a-z0-9-]{1,60}$'),  -- the folder name, like 'frog-hop'
+  idea_by     text check (char_length(idea_by) <= 40),              -- the chat name whose idea it was
+  created_at  timestamptz not null default now()
+-- 2. votes: one vote per person per app, +1 or -1
+  app_slug    text not null references apps (slug) on delete cascade,
+  user_id     uuid not null default auth.uid(),
+  value       smallint not null check (value in (-1, 1)),
+  created_at  timestamptz not null default now(),
+  primary key (app_slug, user_id)   -- the table itself refuses a second vote; change it with an update
+-- 3. scores: runs in your games, for the leaderboards

9a7615a: +// Chat in: a read-only Twitch chat reader. From the Sloppy's Factory kit.
+//         node chat/bot-twitch.mjs --selftest      (checks the parser, no network)
+// Needs Node 22 or newer (it uses Node's built-in WebSocket). No token, no account:
+// it logs in anonymously, the way a logged-out viewer watches chat, so it can only
+// read. It never sends a message. Each chat message becomes one JSON line in
+// When your moderators remove something, it adds a line so /intake can skip it:
+//   {"t":"...","removed":"<login>"}        that user's messages (a timeout or a ban)
+// Remove control characters and invisible direction marks, keep the rest.
+function cut(s) { const a = Array.from(s); return a.length > MAX ? a.slice(0, MAX).join('') + '…' : s; }
+// Parse one raw IRC line into { tags, prefix, command, params } (the last param may hold spaces).
+  const msg = { tags: {}, prefix: '', command: '', params: [] };
+# Save this file as .gitignore in the top folder of your factory,
+# before the first commit. From the Sloppy's Factory kit.
+# Secrets: keys and tokens never go into the repository.
+# Installed packages: reinstall them, never commit them.
+# Chat logs: everything in chat/ stays on the machine,
+# The work tickets and the scratch copies.
+// Station 5, the syntax gate. From the Sloppy's Factory kit.
+// Pulls every inline <script> out of an HTML file and asks Node whether it parses.
+// Prints OK or FAIL and exits 0 or 1. Read the output, not only the exit code.
+  if (/type=["']?(?!module|text\/javascript)/i.test(m[1])) continue; // skip JSON-LD and templates
